comment: Inputs for build_stock.py. Curve/spectrum entries are points CSVs relative to tools/digitize/. labAimDensity: the current 2383 data sheet (Revised 3-22) names LAD on p.3 but prints no numbers and refers to Kodak Publication H-61; H-61B 'LAD for KODAK VISION Color Print Film' states the Status A aim for 2383/3383 as 1.09 red, 1.06 green, 1.03 blue, so H-61B is cited as a second source. The 2383 dye densities are as printed (scaled to a 1.0 visual neutral, not peak-normalised). The two unlabelled UV branches on the spectral-sensitivity graph are digitised but not used; see figures/2383_spectral_sensitivity.json.

sources.title: KODAK VISION Color Print Film 2383 / 3383 data sheet: Diffuse rms Granularity Curves (p.4, F010_0295AC)
sources.note: Digitised from the figure's grain and density curves (figures/2383_granularity.json); each grain point is taken to density through the same figure's density curve by build_stock.py. Sigma D is the datasheet's dimensionless value (multiply by 1000 for the rms figure).

sources.title: assumption: dye-cloud radius 2 um
sources.note: No published dye-cloud size for colour print film was found. Print stock is a slow, fine-grained emulsion whose clouds are smaller than a fast negative's (the 2383 granularity is read at a 48 um aperture the 7219 page states; the 2383 page does not print the aperture and the same one is assumed). Radius 2 um is assumed, about 0.4 of the negative's 5 um (itself from Vitale's secondary 10-15 um cloud size); the M5 fit treats it as adjustable.
